title: $\tau^\tau$-Bench: An Environment for End-To-End, Realistic Agent Construction
abstract: arXiv:2609.04611v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents are rapidly becoming production software, deployed to handle customer service, adjudicate disputes, and operate internal systems. Notably, the work of building them is increasingly handed to coding agents, yet existing benchmarks say little about whether an AI system can deliver one under the conditions of a real client engagement. We introduce $\tau^\tau$-bench (pronounced hyper-tau-bench), a benchmark that makes agent construction the task. A developer agent is given the records a business actually keeps, a client who holds requirements, a production API that operations must run through, a codebase to inherit, and limits on serving cost and models: the same starting point a real engagement provides. From these it must deliver a complete customer-service agent, scored by deploying that agent against held-out simulated users. translated_title: τ²-Bench（超tau基准）：一个用于端到端、真实场景智能体构建的环境
translated_abstract: LLM智能体正迅速成为生产级软件，被部署用于处理客户服务、裁决争议和运营内部系统。值得注意的是，构建这些智能体的工作正越来越多地交给编程智能体来完成，然而现有基准测试几乎无法说明一个AI系统能否在真实客户项目的条件下交付这样的智能体。我们提出了τ²-bench（读作hyper-tau-bench，即“超tau基准”），一个将“智能体构建”本身作为任务的基准。开发者智能体会获得一份企业实际保存的业务记录、一位持有需求的客户、一个运营必须经过的生产API、一个可供继承的代码库，以及对服务成本和模型的限制：这正是真实项目所提供的起点。基于这些条件，它必须交付一个完整的客户服务智能体，评分方式是将该智能体部署到留出的模拟用户上进行测试。在横跨四个领域的53个任务中，表现最强的配置是在Claude Code下运行的Claude Opus 5。
tldr: τ²-bench提出了一个以“构建智能体”本身为任务的新基准，要求开发者智能体在真实客户项目的条件下（业务记录、客户需求、生产API、遗留代码库及成本与模型限制）端到端地交付完整的客户服务智能体，并通过部署到留出的模拟用户上进行评分。
en_tdlr: τ²-bench introduces a benchmark that makes agent construction itself the task, requiring a developer agent to deliver a complete customer-service agent under realistic client-engagement conditions (business records, client requirements, production API, inherited codebase, and cost/model limits), scored by deploying it against held-out simulated users.
